newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt Nov jobs indicator falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt Nov jobs indicator falls.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment fell to minus 0.580 in November from minus 0.534 in October, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
"This suggests that any sustained increase in the rate of employment growth is still some way off," the department said in a statement.
The indicator has fallen steadily every month since a slight rise in May.
The indicator combines seven other indicators, including vehicle registrations, housing approvals and official and private sector measures of job vacancies.
It has been shown to lead employment changes consistently over the long term.
